claim: The ArrayExpress functional-genomics data collection in BioStudies is an external EMBL-EBI resource storing high-throughput functional-genomics experiment metadata, processed data, raw data links, and reusable study records.

BioStudies is an external EMBL-EBI database that holds descriptions of biological studies, links to data in EMBL-EBI and external databases, and orphan/supplementary data that do not fit structured archives.
ClinicalTrials.gov is an external website and online database of clinical research studies and information about their results.
DISGENET is an external platform for gene-disease and disease-genomics knowledge, including NLP-supported disease genomics data and gene-disease associations.
Dryad is an external nonprofit data repository committed to making research data available for reuse and preservation.

The European Genome-phenome Archive is an external service for permanent archiving and sharing of personally identifiable genetic, phenotypic, and clinical biomedical research data under controlled access.
The European Nucleotide Archive is an external resource providing a comprehensive record of nucleotide sequencing information, including raw sequencing data.
Europe PMC is an external free life-sciences literature search resource providing access to trusted literature sources, including abstracts and full text where available.
Figshare is an external research repository infrastructure provider for sharing, showcasing, and managing research outputs in discoverable and citable forms.

NCBI GEO is an external public functional-genomics repository supporting MIAME-compliant array and sequence-based submissions, with tools to query and download experiments and gene-expression profiles.
The NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog is an externally curated collection of human genome-wide association studies and association results that includes MS-relevant trait pages and downloadable GWAS resources.

The International Multiple Sclerosis Genetics Consortium is an external collaborative network producing MS genetics publications and resources; some outputs are open publications while some underlying genotype datasets use controlled access routes.
MSBase is an international online registry and platform for neurologists studying MS and other neuro-immunological diseases, focused on collaborative real-world outcomes research.

The MS Data Alliance Catalogue is an external metadata catalogue for discovering real-world MS data sources; it lists metadata/descriptive data rather than exposing the underlying real-world datasets.
MSGD is an externally curated Multiple Sclerosis Gene Database cataloging MS-related gene knowledge across variants, RNA, protein, knockout, drug-target, and high-throughput entry types.
NARCOMS is an MS registry centered on maintaining a database of individuals' MS experiences and making that information available for research through its consortium processes.

Open Targets Platform is an external data-integration tool for systematic therapeutic target identification and prioritization, including target-disease association evidence and downloadable platform data.
OSF is an external free/open-source research project management and sharing platform that supports private collaboration and public dissemination across the research lifecycle.
PubMed is an external free search and retrieval resource for biomedical and life-sciences literature citations and abstracts, with links to full text where available.
NCBI SRA is an external public repository for high-throughput sequencing data that stores raw sequencing data and alignment information to support reproducibility and reanalysis.
Zenodo is an external multidisciplinary open research repository hosted by CERN/OpenAIRE for preserving and sharing publications, data, software, and other research outputs.
